notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1 – Language Support Update
notes.notes:
🌐 Dual Language Support Added!
We’re excited to announce that the base game is now fully playable in both English and Japanese! A language selection screen has been added at the beginning of the game.

🔧 Changes in v1.1:
Added language selection menu on game start

Implemented full English localization

The base game now supports both English and Japanese

Adjusted UI and text layout for multilingual compatibility

Minor fixes to script and interface

⚠️ Note: The DLC currently only supports English.
Japanese support for the DLC will be available on June 29, 2025.

Thank you for playing and supporting the game!
